description: Loading AFM modules from a URL (mode B). Enabled on this development server by GF_PANELS_DISABLE_SANITIZE_HTML=true.

options.content:
Mode B loads an AFM module from a URL with a native `import()`. The server switch `[panels] disable_sanitize_html = true` must be set; the development server sets it.

The panel on the right points to a URL that does not exist: it must show an error message, not break the dashboard.

title: AFM host remote module
